list.title: Important Information
list.content:
Patch tests are an easy way to make sure you don't experience any initial negative reaction when using a new product. We recommend doing a patch test prior to starting any new product on your skin. Steps for Patch testing:
1. Prepare a small area of skin on the upper forearm by cleaning it thoroughly. Apply a small amount of the product to this patch of skin.
2. Let it sit for 15-20 minutes, but no longer than 30 minutes.
3. If you notice any itching, redness, burning, blistering, or irritation during this time, wash the area immediately and refrain from using the product.

It's important to note that a patch test is only intended to detect early signs of irritation in response to the product and does not ensure similar reactions elsewhere on the body, such as the face, or with regular use. Furthermore, it doesn't account for any underlying skin conditions and should not be used to diagnose hypersensitivity or allergic contact dermatitis.

list.title: Does it help with cracked, rough heels?
list.content: Yes, it does. Urea, present in the product, is a humectant that attracts moisture to the skin, softening and hydrating dry, rough areas. It also gently exfoliates by breaking down dead skin cells, which helps smooth out tough skin patches.

list.title: Does this roll on eliminate foot callous?
list.content: Yes, this 20% Urea Roll On can eliminate symptoms like calluses and heel fissures as it has exfoliating properties.

list.title: How is this different from other foot creams?
list.content: This roll on contains the most potent formulation to treat cracked, rough and dry heels. Urea & Lactic acid present exfoliates dead skin buildup, promotes skin cell turnover, and deeply moisturizes. Roll on format makes it mess-free and convenient to use.

list.title: Is it safe to use?
list.content: Yes, it is 100% safe to use.

list.title: How long will it take to heal cracked heel?
list.content: It depends on the severity, but we recommend to use it daily for 3 months for best results.
